{{Otheruses|Honor Guard}}
The '''Coruscant Honor Guard''' was a unit that existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the era of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were noted for traditionally using [[Force staff]]s that were similar in design to [[Electropole/Legends|electropoles]].
